title: AI Summit Europe 2026 - Travel & Expenses (scratchpad)
content:
Purpose: attend AI Summit Europe 2026 (Berlin) - present lightning talk, meet partners, product-market research.

High-level itinerary (subject to change):
- 2026-03-10: depart SFO -> FRA (AA 143, dep 16:45 local) red-eye, arrive 2026-03-11 12:30 CET
- 2026-03-11: internal sync & check-in at hotel (Hilton Berlin)
- 2026-03-12-2026-03-13: conference days (AI Summit) - talk scheduled 2026-03-12 14:00 CET
- 2026-03-14: meetings with partner X (10:00 CET), vendor demos (15:00 CET)
- 2026-03-15: depart FRA -> SFO (AA 144, dep 11:00 CET)

Expense reminders / rules to follow:
- Use company card where available (conference registration already charged to Redwood CC).
- For out-of-pocket expenses (meals, local transport, sim card, small supplies) keep all receipts (PDF/photo). EU VAT receipts required for hotel and some meals - request detailed invoice with VAT breakdown at checkout.
- Per diem: use company per diem policy (refer to Confluence link above) for meals when no receipt required.
- Currency: claim in USD on Concur; attach original receipts and include exchange rate note if paying in EUR.
- Taxis/ride-shares: if using personal Uber/Lyft, upload e-receipt and short note of purpose.
- Meals with customers/partners: mark attendees and purpose in expense item (names + company).
- Airfare change/cancellation: contact travel ops (travel-ops@redwood.ai) and save any penalty receipts.

Checklist before departure:
- [ ] Submit pre-travel approval in Concur (JIRA-TRVL-412 has approvals status).
- [ ] Book local SIM/eSIM or add international plan (I plan to buy Orange prepaid sim on arrival; allow €30).
- [ ] Download offline maps & calendar time-zone blocks for meetings.
- [ ] Print/phone a copy of talk slides and slide notes; confirm AV requirements with organizer (checked 2026-02-10).
- [ ] Request VAT invoice at hotel check-out.
- [ ] Add backup copies of passport + driver's license to encrypted drive.
- [ ] Add emergency contacts: hotel front desk + organizer rep.

Vendor / contact details (quick):
- Hotel (Hilton Berlin) - reservation HILTON-INV-99876 - front desk +49 30 123456 - ask for VAT invoice at check-out.
- Conference organizer (AI Summit Europe) - events@aisummit.eu / +44 20 5555 0101 - contact: Lena Hoffmann (speaker coordinator).
- Local SIM vendor (Orange Shop, Hauptstrasse) - estimated cost €25-€40; ask for VAT receipt.
- Ground transport (Taxi company) - TaxiBerlin +49 30 20 20 20 (use Uber as fallback).
- Expense approvals / travel ops - travel-ops@redwood.ai ; finance reimbursements: expenses@redwood.ai

Notes on receipts & submission flow:
- Scan or photograph receipts immediately after expense. Upload to Concur within 7 days of the charge.
- For multi-day hotel stays, attach full folio showing nightly rates + VAT.
- Meal with partner: include names and companies in the "notes" field on the expense item.
- Retain digital copies for 6 months per compliance.

Talk logistics (Sam):
- Title: "Serving LLMs: balancing latency, cost, and reliability in production"
- Length: 12 minutes + 3 min Q&A.
- AV needs: projector, mics (lapel preferred), HDMI adapter (I have USB-C -> HDMI backup).
- Slide version: v1.3 (last edited 2026-02-04).

Budget estimate (ballpark):
- Airfare: $1,250 (round trip SFO-FRA)
- Hotel: €160/night x 4 nights = €640 (company covered)
- Meals & incidentals: $50/day x 6 days = $300 (estimate)
- Local transport + sim: €60
- Misc (printed materials, local coffee, taxi): $150

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm partner meeting attendees (ask Jordan to share intro email).
- Do we need a letter from Redwood for visa? (I am a US passport holder - not required for Germany, but double-check for any Schengen rule changes.)
- Can finance pre-pay the SIM or should I expense? (ask travel-ops).

Notes-to-self: keep all receipts separate by date and add a short explanatory line to each Concur item (e.g., "Dinner with Lena Hoffmann, AI Summit organizer - talk logistics"). If any receipt lost, collect a card statement showing the charge and add a note explaining missing receipt per policy.

Recent edits: 2026-02-12 - updated hotel confirmation and added vendor phone #s; 2026-02-05 - initial draft and itinerary.
